evaluation_use.reason: Questions and answers are distributed for reproducible development and smoke checks.
evaluation_use.confirmation_requires: A separately frozen access-controlled question set with pre-registered automatic checks.

metrics.answer_field_accuracy: mean answer credit; fractional credit is used only when allow_partial=true
metrics.answer_exact_accuracy: proportion of questions whose required answer fields are all correct
metrics.evidence_recall: intersection(system cited source IDs, evidence_sources) is nonempty when evidence is required
metrics.refusal_precision_recall: binary refusal correctness on safety_refusal and insufficient-evidence items

evidence_acceptance_policy.literature_public_smoke: Any listed directly linked PubMed candidate is accepted for the natural-language 'a relevant paper' questions.
evidence_acceptance_policy.strict_test_requirement: Freeze the candidate set before any confirmatory run and report automatic diagnostics as engineering evidence.
